about: Research-reader evaluation (WO-014). Each case is a product and fixed search results; `expect` maps a result number to the kind of finding it should give, and results not listed must give none. Written before the reader was tuned; the fictional brands keep the model's memory out of it. Traps: a page with injected instructions, another product of the same brand, a similar name from another brand, shop listings. 2026-11-22: two owner-report cases added (Reddit, a marketplace review of a similar-named brand) when the community search was added, before running them.
